about.title: Clear plans.
about.intro: I'm Kami, a Roblox Project Lead.
paragraphs: I take Roblox games from roadmap to launch, and keep them growing after. My work sits between the idea and the players: turning big ideas into a plan a team can actually ship, then keeping that team pointed at the next release.

I've worked on Roblox projects reaching 85M+ visits and communities of 170K+, as Project Manager on Anime Guardians and Slimebound, and as Project Lead on Multiversal and now Anime Infinite. Ascension Arena is my own game, where I'm the founder and lead developer.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Broad goals become clear milestones, owners, priorities and delivery windows, so everyone knows what is next and why.

steps.title: Coordinate
steps.text: Developers, artists, builders and community teams stay aligned around the next release, with blockers cleared early.

steps.title: Ship
steps.text: Scope stays visible, progress is tracked, and every release gets checklists, QA passes and clear content priorities.

steps.title: Grow
steps.text: After launch I stay on the game: retention, economy health, events and player feedback, so the next update lands better than the last.

about.timeline_sub: Tap a project for the details.

skills.title: What I bring
skills.sub: Two halves of one job: getting a game built and launched, then keeping it healthy once players arrive.

items.name: Roadmap planning
items.text: Turns broad goals into clear milestones, owners, priorities and delivery windows.

items.name: Team coordination
items.text: Keeps developers, artists, builders and community teams aligned around the next release.

items.name: Production oversight
items.text: Tracks progress, removes blockers and keeps scope visible before issues become costly.

items.name: Launch preparation
items.text: Prepares release checklists, QA passes, content priorities and live-operation handoffs.

items.name: Retention analysis
items.text: Monitors player retention, finds drop-off points and evaluates progression systems to improve long-term engagement.

items.name: Economy & monetization
items.text: Analyses monetization performance and economy health, balancing revenue with player experience.

items.name: Event & content strategy
items.text: Plans retention-focused events and content designed to increase player activity and long-term engagement.

items.name: KPI tracking & analysis
items.text: Tracks retention, revenue, engagement and update performance to judge overall game health.

items.name: Community feedback
items.text: Weighs player feedback alongside game data to find issues, prioritise fixes and support better decisions.
